rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a change or alteration, rather than for a separate version or alternative method.

example.english: There is a lot of variation in the weather this year.
example.jyutping: gam1 nin4 tin1 hei3 ge3 bin3 faa3 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Use this when the variation is an alternative way of doing something, as in trying a different process.

example.english: If this method does not suit you, you can try another variation.
example.traditional: 呢個做法唔啱你，可以試另一種方法。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zou6 faat3 m4 ngaam1 nei5 ho2 ji5 si3 ling6 jat1 zung2 fong1 faat3

rows.note: Use this when the variation is presented as a distinct version of the same thing.

example.english: This song also has another variation sung in Cantonese.
example.traditional: 呢首歌仲有另一個版本，係用廣東話唱嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 zung6 jau5 ling6 jat1 go3 baan2 bun2 hai6 jung6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 coeng3 ge3
